findings.text: The done_when asks that the tests importing the changed modules add no failure against a base arm, but the population arm was measured at 929954a504 and the delivered code head c48f8e4292 carries d5216d34ae, which rewrites sweep_stale_arm_trees. tests/test_a_landing_arm_leaves_no_tree.py is the only file that exercises the refactored removal loop's real behaviour (holder skip, age bound, size, rmtree) and it was not re-run at the delivered head, so its green result predates the code under review. Non-blocking because the refactor is a behaviour-preserving consolidation and the shared-loop test at the head passes, but the population claim is measured one code commit stale.

The delayed-sweep test asserts argv[argv.index('--wrap') + 1] == landing_measure.arm_sweep_command(3600.0, Path('/home/example/reckon')), which compares the submitted wrap against a fresh call to the same function the code under test used, so both sides move together and a defect inside arm_sweep_command (a wrong entry point, bound or interpreter) leaves the assertion true. It would fail only if _submit_delayed_sweep stopped using arm_sweep_command at all. The content of the command is separately guarded by tests/test_a_landing_arm_leaves_no_tree.py:164-173, which is why this is non-blocking.

The call to _submit_delayed_sweep from the arm's failure path (the 'selected_limit and not submission_failed and (timed_out or not receipts)' branch) has no asserting test: deleting the call leaves the suite green, and tests/test_a_partitioned_arm_unpacks_what_it_needs.py:298 tests the helper in isolation. The fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/delivered-work-lands-without-a-coordinator/delivered-work-lands-without-a-coordinator-s63.html:62 accordingly overstates that 'a test asserts each of the three places a job script carries the sweep in ... and the delayed sweep'. Non-blocking: the helper is tested and the wiring was present before this refactor.

The reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite fields are free-text lines ('bf5ff985a74a 58 passed ... EXIT=0, command ...') rather than the JSON objects the record contract declares for those keys, so a reader parsing them as JSON gets nothing. Non-blocking for this node because the named logs carry every field the JSON would.
